articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Northrop Grumman Torpedo Win And Rocket Tests Frame Valuation Debate. Northrop Grumman (NYSE:NOC) secured a US$233 million US Navy contract for an advanced lightweight torpedo program. The torpedo effort includes collaboration with the Australian Defense Force on design and development. The company also completed successful tests of new solid rocket motors aimed at faster production timelines. Hungary’s MOL Group has signed a new strategic partnership with Libya’s National Oil Corporation (NOC), marking a fresh step in the company’s push to expand its international upstream footprint and diversify crude supply sources.
